dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Going to get a new job?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Oh no no, I don't actually have any plans to open a shop. It was just an analogy.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Once you've worked here for long enough, you'll see just about anything.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Get distracted for one second, and something in a package gets broken.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Get distracted again, and the delivery address literally evaporates into thin air, because it was written in that kind of ink that changes with the outside temperature...

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* Forget it. There's no point going into it. There'll only be more pleasant surprises waiting for us.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Sorry you had to listen to all of that. I hope I didn't take up too much of your time.
